title: Compact handoff renderer producing a short live message and repository-relative modular baton index

content.hypothesis: A compact renderer can preserve exact anchors, route, gates, and card pointers without transmitting a monolithic baton body.
content.null_or_failure_condition: The compact message omits terminal truth or gates, contains a private absolute path, or exceeds the configured budget.
content.execution_lane: x2 owner-local structural, synthetic, symbolic, or software evidence only
content.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject unless the declared fixture passes, every negative mutation is retained, and the output makes no claim beyond its evidence class.
content.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the failed card or deck, preserve the witness, restore the last valid content-addressed manifest, and rerun only the failed dependency.

relational_boundary: Working-language record only; not consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification, or authority evidence.
